name: RTSS Frame Limit
description: Sets the RivaTuner Statistics Server frame rate limit to the client's frame rate for the length of the stream, then restores the previous limit. Requires RTSS 7.3.7 or newer.
author: Sunshine

options.label: RTSS profiles
options.description: Comma-separated RTSS profiles to change, such as Global or MyGame.exe.

options.label: Start RTSS if it isn't running
options.description: Start RivaTuner Statistics Server for the stream if it isn't already running, and close it again afterwards. An RTSS you started yourself is left running.

options.label: Re-apply the limit when a client resumes
options.description: Set the limit again when a client resumes the running application, using that client's frame rate. Turn this off to keep the limit from when the stream started.
